from src.shop.cart import Cart


def test_add_item():
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add("Widget", 9.99, 2)
    assert cart.item_count() == 2


def test_add_same_item_twice_merges():
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add("Widget", 9.99, 1)
    cart.add("Widget", 9.99, 3)
    assert cart.item_count() == 4


def test_add_multiple_items():
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add("Widget", 9.99, 1)
    cart.add("Gadget", 4.50, 2)
    assert cart.item_count() == 3


def test_total():
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add("Widget", 9.99, 2)
    assert cart.total() == 19.98


def test_total_multiple_items():
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add("Widget", 9.99, 2)
    cart.add("Gadget", 4.50, 1)
    assert cart.total() == 24.48


def test_empty_cart_count():
    cart = Cart()
    assert cart.item_count() == 0


def test_empty_cart_total():
    cart = Cart()
    assert cart.total() == 0


def test_checkout_returns_total_with_tax():
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add("Widget", 100.00, 1)
    charged = cart.checkout(region="pk")
    assert charged == 117.0
